welcome_permissions|Notification and battery optimization exemption permissions will be requested. The exemption helps keep speech active with the screen off. The selected resampler converts audio when the output rate differs from the synthesis rate. A higher output rate alone does not guarantee better sound.|Der klassische Modus beginnt bei 11.025 Hz.
